**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Sparkling, which satisfies the preferred position under NONCOMPETE. The only restrictive language binding us is § 3, which is standard licence-scope protection for Garman's Software (backup-only copying, no sublicence, no reverse engineering, no use beyond the grant) — it does not constrain what products we may buy, build or market, nor our freedom to deal with Garman's competitors. Section 19's one-year non-solicit is mutual and concerns employees, not competing business, so it falls outside this rule.
